name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a Qiskit program that builds a 4-q
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a Qiskit program that builds a 4-qubit QFT circuit, exports it to OpenQASM 2 and OpenQASM 3 strings, prints both, and re-imports the QASM 3 version to verify operator equivalence. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
